Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in while driving in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently receive mail.
A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the car that was hit. I can give you my mailing address if you need it.
Q: That's fine, we'll note the address on file. Can you walk me through what happened?
A: I was making a left turn at an intersection with a green light, or what I believed was a green. I was going slowly
because traffic was heavy. Then a veihcle coming from the opposite direction hit the front passenger side of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I looked before I turned, but it seemed clear. I think it came up fast on the other side of the median.
Q: Were you able to stop or steer away?
A: No, there wasn't much time. It all happened in a second or two.
Q: Did anyone get hurt, and have you sought medical attention?
A: My neck hurts quite a bit, mostly stiffness and a dull ache going into my shoulders. I went to an urgent care clinic
that same day. They said it looked like a neck strain and gave me a prescription for pain relief and told me to rest it.
Q: Are you still having symptoms now?
A: Yes, I still get stiffness when I turn my head, and it's worse in the mornings. I've been doing some gentle stretches
the doctor suggested.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want my car taken care of properly. It's been a hassle getting a rental arranged.
Q: Understood. This concludes the recorded statement. Thank you.
A: Thank you.
</page>

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
